toolsAndAccess.title: Tools & Access
toolsAndAccess.enforcementBannerDescription1: Persistent at the top of the Tools & Access surface. Tints to denied-detected when governed tool calls were denied or failed in the last hour. Observability only — enforcement lives in the tool gateway.
toolsAndAccess.enforcementBannerDescription2: Static governance copy with a tone. Used for the PAP-10400 trust-tier banner on Runtime and the effective-access banner on Agent → Tools. Pass title/body and an optional icon.
toolsAndAccess.effectiveAccessBody: This is exactly what the tool gateway will accept. Profile and policy edits reflect within ~5s; the prompt cannot expand it.
toolsAndAccess.localStdioTitle: Local stdio is local code execution, not a security sandbox.
toolsAndAccess.localStdioBody: A local-stdio slot runs with the orchestrator's privileges. Only bind trusted commands; quarantine anything you would not run yourself.
toolsAndAccess.runtimeFailedBody: The supervisor is restarting (attempt 2/3). The gateway returns runtime-error and the agent does not see partial output.
toolsAndAccess.actionCardPendingDescription: Signed payload sha256 + expiry surface on every variant (PAP-10400). The stale variant tints the border amber, banners the catalog-hash mismatch, strikes through the previous hash next to the current one, and renders Approve disabled until the request is re-issued.
toolsAndAccess.actionCardMobileDescription: Identical content; the three buttons stack full-width in the order Approve / Deny / Edit & re-sign, and the bindings table uses a 70px label column.
toolsAndAccess.bindingsTable: BindingsTable (reused in the audit row drilldown)
toolsAndAccess.bindingsTableDescription: Two-column key/value block with mono values. Lives inside ActionCard and is reused standalone in the audit row drilldown.
toolsAndAccess.toolAccessStatusDescription: Policy decisions, connection/runtime health, and catalog quarantine all route through the canonical StatusBadge keys defined in lib/status-colors.
toolsAndAccess.emptyStateDescription: Add a connection to an application to configure credentials and discover its tools.

envVarsEditor.title: Environment Variables Editor
envVarsEditor.description: Reusable env-var editor (agents, projects, environments, routines). One shared grid, an in-field Text/Secret source switch, a fuzzy secret picker with a pinned "Create secret" item, automatic sensitive-value detection, and inline secret-health warnings. See the Storybook Product/Environment Variables Editor stories for all 10 states.

resizablePanels.title: Resizable Panels
resizablePanels.description: Design-system wrapper over react-resizable-panels (Skill Studio D2). Drag a handle to resize; panels accept percentage or pixel (minSize="240px") constraints and the middle panel is collapsible. Use anywhere a split view is needed.

inlineBanner.title: Inline Banner
inlineBanner.description: Token-backed full-width notice (brandBanner tones). Use info for provenance/context and warning for paused/attention. Supports an optional bold title and a trailing actions slot. Replaces hand-rolled bg-yellow-*/bg-blue-* banners.
inlineBanner.builtInAgentBody: Ships with Paperclip and powers Briefs. It can be paused but not deleted.
inlineBanner.briefsPausedBody: Its built-in agent was paused 2 days ago, so new briefs aren't being generated.

builtInLifecycle.title: Built-in Agent Lifecycle Chips
builtInLifecycle.description1: A derived lifecycle chip (amber) for attention states. The lifecycle chip is separate from the agent status vocabulary and only shows for needs_setup / pending_approval.
builtInLifecycle.description2: <BuiltInAgentGate agentKey> composes PageSkeleton + EmptyState + InlineBanner to render the loading / setup / pending-approval / paused / ready states of a feature that depends on a built-in agent.
